title: Grateful Dead Live at Shrine Auditorium on 1967-11-10
lineage: SBD Reel from WB Vault to reel @ 7.5 IPS to reel@ 7.5 IPS to digital domain. Korg MR 1000 at 1 bit 5.6 mhz to 24-96 via Korg software. Taped by: Dan Healy; Transfer By: Matt Smith & Bob Menke; Mastering By: Derek McCabe

ai_review.summary: Soundboard source with no clear audio or performance details; reviewers give minimal feedback.
ai_review.review: The few reviews provide almost no information about the music or sound quality – one reviewer simply asks if this is a duplicate of another file, another notes a bit‑depth difference, and only a single 5‑star rating is offered without comment. Consequently there are no identifiable standout moments or technical issues to highlight.

ai_rating.rationale: Only three brief reviews; two are non‑evaluative (0 stars) and one is a bare 5‑star rating. Lack of substantive commentary makes it difficult to assess show or recording quality, leading to an average estimate with low confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No reviewers commented on clarity, mix, or other technical aspects; the file name suggests a soundboard source but audio quality cannot be judged from the available feedback.
